items.claim: Milos is a very talented, exciting standup striker with a violent kickboxing style.
items.quote: He's a standup striker. He's very talented and he's very exciting.

items.claim: Gle could expose a little hole in Milos's game.
items.quote: I just feel like maybe Gle could expose a little hole in his game.

items.claim: Marina Spasic does not have great pace or striking abilities.
items.quote: I don't think she's got great pace. I don't think she's got great striking abilities.

items.claim: Stephanie Luciano does not tire and puts up a high volume pace fight in the third round.
items.quote: the third round, it's like Luciano does not tire. And when you cannot take her down, she really puts up a high volume pace fight.

items.claim: Stephanie Luciano has trouble against bigger, stronger physical fighters that can rough her up and take her down.
items.quote: It's the against bigger, stronger physical fighters that can rough her up and take her down is where she has troubles.

items.claim: Stephanie Luciano's takedown defense and counter grappling are vastly improving.
items.quote: At 26, the hole in her game is takedown defense in counter grappling and that's all vastly improving

items.claim: Marina Spasic lost to a 5-2 regional fighter just two fights ago.
items.quote: She lost to a 5-2 regional fighter just two fights ago.

items.claim: Marina Spasic is 32 years old and is a fully developed product.
items.quote: Marina Spage is 32 years old. This is the end of the line, dog. What she is is what she is. Developed product
